modalities.evidence: fMRI responses are decoded into the latent features

output.population: Whole-brain fMRI from five subjects (S1–S5) viewing 3D objects presented as 2D rendered images (monocular pictorial cues) or random dot stereograms
output.summary: Whole-brain fMRI while participants viewed 3D objects shown as 2D rendered images or random dot stereograms, used to decode perceived cue-invariant 3D object structure from visual cortex activity.
